description_en: You can call the DescribeAccelerator operation to query information about a specified Global Accelerator instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAccelerator接口查询指定的全球加速实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance

Bandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth of the standard Global Accelerator instance. Unit: Mbps.

This parameter is valid only when the access mode of the acceleration area is Anycast
Bandwidth.description_zh:
标准型全球加速实例带宽。单位：Mbps。
仅加速区域接入模式为Anycast时有效

BandwidthBillingType.description_en:
The billing method of the bandwidth. Valid values:

BandwidthPackage: pay-by-bandwidth-plan.

CDT: pay-by-data-transfer
BandwidthBillingType.description_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：

BandwidthPackage：按带宽包计费。

CDT：按流量计费

BasicBandwidthPackage.description_en: The details of the basic bandwidth plan that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance
BasicBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 全球加速实例绑定的基础带宽包的详情

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the basic bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbps
Bandwidth.description_zh: 基础带宽包的带宽值。单位：Mbps

BandwidthType.description_en:
The type of the bandwidth of the basic bandwidth plan. Valid values:

Basic: standard acceleration bandwidth.

Enhanced: enhanced acceleration bandwidth.

Advanced: premium acceleration bandwidth
BandwidthType.description_zh:
基础带宽包的带宽类型。取值：

Basic：标准加速带宽。

Enhanced：增强加速带宽。

Advanced：精品加速带宽

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the basic bandwidth plan

CenId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance
CenId.description_zh: 全球加速实例绑定的云企业网实例ID

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the Global Accelerator instance was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 全球加速实例创建时间的时间戳

CrossBorderMode.description_en:
The type of cross-border acceleration. This parameter is returned for pay-by-data-transfer instances.

bpgPro: premium bandwidth for cross-border acceleration
CrossBorderMode.description_zh:
用于带宽计费方式为按流量计费（CDT）的实例，显示其跨境加速类型，取值：

bpgPro：精品带宽跨境加速
CrossBorderMode.title_en: 当前实例的跨境网络类型，用于按量付费实例，显示其是用专线跨境还是精品公网跨境
CrossBorderMode.title_zh: 当前实例的跨境网络类型，用于按量付费实例，显示其是用专线跨境还是精品公网跨境

CrossBorderStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the cross-border line feature is enabled for the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

true: The cross-border line feature is enabled. You can use Global Accelerator to accelerate data transmission across borders.

false: The cross-border line feature is disabled. You cannot use Global Accelerator to accelerate data transmission across borders
CrossBorderStatus.description_zh:
全球加速实例是否开启跨境线路功能。取值：

true：开启跨境线路功能，可以加速跨境线路。

false：关闭跨境线路功能，不可以加速跨境线路

CrossDomainBandwidthPackage.description_en:
The details of the cross-region bandwidth plan that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance.

This parameter is returned only by the Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com)
CrossDomainBandwidthPackage.description_zh:
全球加速实例绑定的跨地域加速包的详情。

仅国际站支持返回该数组

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the cross-region bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbps
Bandwidth.description_zh: 跨地域加速包的带宽值，单位：Mbps

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cross-region bandwidth plan

CrossPrivateState.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-border bandwidth is enabled.

true: enabled.

false: disabled
CrossPrivateState.description_zh:
是否开启了跨地域带宽跨境。

true：是。

false：否

DdosConfigList.description_en: The list of Anti-DDoS instances that are associated with the Global Accelerator instance
DdosConfigList.description_zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的DDoS高防实例列表

DdosId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance
DdosId.description_zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的DDoS高防实例ID

DdosRegionId.description_en:
The region where the Anti-DDoS instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
DdosRegionId.description_zh:
DDoS高防实例所在的地域，取值：

cn-hangzhou：中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：非中国内地

DdosId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance
DdosId.description_zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的DDoS高防实例ID

Description.description_en: The description of the Global Accelerator instance
Description.description_zh: 全球加速实例的描述信息

DnsName.description_en: The canonical name (CNAME) that is assigned to the Global Accelerator instance
DnsName.description_zh: 全球加速实例分配的CNAME地址

ExpiredTime.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the Global Accelerator instance expires
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 全球加速实例到期时间的时间戳

InstanceChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the Global Accelerator instance
InstanceChargeType.description_zh: 全球加速实例的计费方式

IpSetConfig.description_en: The configuration of the acceleration area

AccessMode.description_en:
The access mode of the acceleration area. Valid values:

UserDefine: custom. You can select acceleration areas and regions based on your business needs. Global Accelerator provides a separate elastic IP address (EIP) for each acceleration region.

Anycast: automatic. You do not need to configure an acceleration area. Global Accelerator provides an Anycast EIP for multiple regions. Users can connect to the nearest access point of the Alibaba Cloud network using the Anycast EIP
AccessMode.description_zh:
加速区域接入模式。取值：

UserDefine：自定义就近接入模式。您可以根据业务需要，定向选择加速区域和地域，全球加速为每个加速地域提供独立的EIP。
Anycast：采用自动就近接入模式。您无需配置加速区域。全球加速在全球多地域提供一个Anycast EIP，用户可通过Anycast EIP从就近接入点进入阿里云加速网络

Name.description_en: The name of the Global Accelerator instance

RegionId.description_en: The region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed
RegionId.description_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SecondDnsName.description_en: The CNAME of the Anti-DDoS instance that is associated with the Global Accelerator instance
SecondDnsName.description_zh: 全球加速联动DDoS高防实例的CNAME

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:

true: The instance is a managed instance.

false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that you can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.

When the instance is managed, you cannot perform some operations on the instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The actions that you can perform on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create: creates an instance.

Update: updates the current instance.

Delete: deletes the current instance.

Associate: associates the instance with other resources.

UserUnmanaged: unmanages the instance.

CreateChild: creates a child resource in the instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener.

IpSet: acceleration region.

EndpointGroup: endpoint group.

ForwardingRule: forwarding rule.

Endpoint: endpoint.

EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group associated with a custom routing listener.

EndpointPolicy: access policy of an endpoint associated with a custom routing listener.

This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified action is managed. Valid values:

true: The action is managed. You cannot perform the specified action on the managed instance.

false: The action is not managed. You can perform the specified action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：

true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。

false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

Spec.description_en:
The specification of the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

1: Small I.

2: Small II.

3: Small III.

5: Medium I.

8: Medium II.

10: Medium III.

20: Large I.

30: Large II.

40: Large III.

50: Large IV.

60: Large V.

70: Large VI.

80: Large VII.

90: Large VIII.

100: Super Large I.

200: Super Large II.

The Large III and higher specifications are available only to users on the whitelist. To use these specifications, contact your account manager.

The definitions of different specifications vary. For more information, see [Instance specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153127.html）
Spec.description_zh:
全球加速实例的规格，取值：

1：小型Ⅰ。
2：小型Ⅱ。
3：小型Ⅲ。
5：中型Ⅰ。
8：中型Ⅱ。
10：中型Ⅲ。
20：大型Ⅰ。
30：大型Ⅱ。
40：大型Ⅲ。
50：大型IV。
60：大型V。
70：大型VI。
80：大型VII。
90：大型VIII。
100：超大型Ⅰ。
200：超大型Ⅱ。

目前，大型Ⅲ及以上规格仅白名单开放。如需使用，请联系阿里云客户经理。

实例规格不同，定义也不同。更多信息，请参见[实例规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153127.html）

State.description_en:
The status of the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

init: The instance is being initialized.

active: The instance is available.

configuring: The instance is being configured.

binding: The instance is being associated.

unbinding: The instance is being disassociated.

deleting: The instance is being deleted.

finacialLocked: The instance is financially locked
State.description_zh:
全球加速实例的状态。取值：

init：初始化。

active：可用。

configuring：配置中。

binding：绑定中。

unbinding：解绑中。

deleting：删除中。

finacialLocked：欠费锁定

UpgradableStatus.description_en:
The upgrade status of the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

notUpgradable: The instance does not need to be upgraded.

upgradable: The instance can be upgraded.

upgradeFailed: The instance failed to be upgraded
UpgradableStatus.description_zh:
全球加速实例的可升级状态。取值：
notUpgradable：当前实例不需要升级。
upgradable：当前实例可升级至最新版本。
upgradeFailed：当前实例执行过升级操作且升级失败
